title: ID0455200-DC/Si-D/GB-[ Y2/T5314234864003] Charger not online
description:

Solution: Flash CFAST or delete Error-flags.json via Linux

additional_info.subject: ID0455200-DC/Si-D/GB-[ Y2/T5314234864003] Charger not online CRM:03098000018
additional_info.body:
Hi Jason, good morning
As we checked yesterday the sicharge-cp-backend crashed and is no longer recoverable.
Please flash the CFAST and restore config with LiveLinux. If it's not possible to do restore config, please create the new ID and let me know what it is so that I can delete the old one.
Do not forget that if you proceed with the new ID, you need to flash the routers again.
Let me know when you have feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
